sourceDocuments.title: Monetary Policy Transmission and Foreign Exchange Fluctuations
sourceDocuments.text: Devaluation of the official exchange rate triggers domestic cost-push inflation through imported intermediate manufacturing inputs and escalating transport logistics.

studentDocument.title: Macroeconomic Impact of Currency Depreciation
studentDocument.text: When national monetary authorities adjust official currency exchange rates downward, consumer prices generally rise as industrial manufacturers pass higher import costs onto retail markets.
